email.subject: Quick note on Mainline Pros' site
email.body:
Hi Grace,

I took a look at the Mainline Pros Plumbing site. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no way to book online, so anyone searching after hours just calls the next plumber in Harbor Falls, and there are no reviews showing, which makes new customers hesitate before calling a plumber they don't know.

Both are fixable without a redesign. I fix local business sites for a flat fee, one person, no retainer.

Want a free 10-minute walkthrough? I'll show you exactly what I'd change and why.

Alex
